title: Phase III Study of Palbociclib Plus Endocrine Therapy in HR-Positive HER2-Negative Breast Cancer
description: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of palbociclib in combination with standard endocrine therapy in patients with hormone receptor positive, HER2 negative advanced breast cancer who have not received prior systemic therapy for advanced disease.
eligibility: Inclusion: Women aged 18 or older, HR-positive HER2-negative breast cancer, ECOG performance status 0 or 1, no prior CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy. Exclusion: Prior chemotherapy for metastatic disease, active CNS metastases, serious cardiac conditions.
